interpretation.known_cohorts: These test scores have already been inspected under other settings. This run is method characterisation, not fresh independent validation or a candidate-selection experiment.
interpretation.charges: RDKit Gasteiger-Marsili; not SYBYL Gasteiger-Huckel. Different molecular charge sources are not silently relabelled.
interpretation.parameters: Public Tripos-5.2 R/K subset and explicit organic-H/S environment rules; not the complete SYBYL atom typer or proof that SYBYL 6.6/other versions use identical tables.
interpretation.preprocessing: Train-only block scaling, fold-local masks/means/selection and n/5 cap remain SARscope settings, not established numerical SYBYL preprocessing parity.
interpretation.missingness: Undefined CoMFA terms stay NaN at field calculation. The explicit modelling policy uses fitting-column means and reports replaced terms. The 10% overall/per-electrostatic-field flag is configurable engineering policy, not a published SYBYL validity cutoff.
interpretation.unsupported: SYBYL hydrophobic data.lip tables and directional H-bond extension-point generation are not implemented in this profile; no Crippen or atom-centred indicator substitution.
interpretation.no_claim: No full SYBYL equivalence, full-package validation, superiority, novel 3D-QSAR algorithm or prospective predictivity claim. Reserved ATA evaluation remains unrun.
